observations.summary: HANRI/control workflow allowed stale R35/R28 evidence to remain visually CURRENT in the dashboard until the operator challenged it.
observations.proposed_change: audit freshness and supersession semantics before presenting any current-state claim as green

observations.summary: Agent needs a reusable evidence-first current-truth verification procedure before proposing live-adapter changes.
observations.proposed_change: create a current-truth verification skill that resolves supersession, freshness and evidence strength before any implementation proposal

observations.summary: The dashboard reload path can re-render stale embedded bytes instead of re-reading current evidence sources.
observations.proposed_change: separate evidence ingestion from browser rendering and regenerate the projection from verified source readbacks

observations.summary: Operator had to manually challenge HANRI scope and dashboard truth instead of receiving proactive meta-audit findings.
observations.proposed_change: surface a concise proactive attention report: what HANRI audited, what it did not audit, what needs operator judgment, and which improvements are proposed
